tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Dictionary entries for a Chinese word, a pinyin syllable or a Vietnamese word: simplified and traditional forms, pinyin, Hán Việt per character (Thiều Chửu), Vietnamese senses (CVDICT), English senses (CC-CEDICT), HSK level. tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Everything known about one character: Hán Việt readings (Thiều Chửu first, Unihan when Thiều Chửu has none), pinyin readings, a short English gloss, stroke count, radical, its parts (decomposition) and how it was formed (etymology: the meaning part and the sound part, each with its Hán Việt), and it

tools.name: words_with
tools.description: Words of two characters or more that contain a character (simplified or traditional), HSK words first, then shorter words. Each comes as a full entry: pinyin, Hán Việt, Vietnamese and English senses, HSK level, `src` per field.

tools.name: search_meaning
tools.description: Vietnamese or English → Chinese: entries whose Vietnamese (CVDICT) or English (CC-CEDICT) senses match the meaning, HSK words first. These are candidates, not one translation: compare their senses and HSK levels before picking one, and say when several fit.

tools.name: annotate_text

tools.name: suggest_correction
tools.description: Sends a correction for a wrong or missing value (Hán Việt, Vietnamese meaning, English, pinyin, a missing word) as a public GitHub issue in OpenCidian/opencidian-data; a maintainer reviews it, nothing changes in the data until then. tools.name: about
tools.description: The dataset's version and build date, its licence (CC BY-SA 4.0), the full attribution to quote when reusing it, and every source with its pinned version and licence (CC-CEDICT, CVDICT, Thiều Chửu, Unihan, Make Me a Hanzi, the HSK lists). Use it to say where an answer comes from or how to cite OpenC
